 IMPACT to Host LIHEAP Assistance Event at Knoxville Public Library
 Clayton Sampson 
 October 30, 2026 
 @ 
 4:57 am 
 Share: 
 Copied! 
 IMPACT Community Action Partnership will be at the Knoxville Public Library on Thursday, November 5th, to help Marion County residents apply for assistance with their winter heating bills. 
 The event will run from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., with scheduled appointments available from 10:00 a.m. until noon and walk-in applications beginning at 1:00 p.m. The event is part of the 2026-2027 Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, also known as LIHEAP, which provides financial assistance to eligible households to help cover heating costs and prevent utility disconnections. Residents applying for assistance should bring documentation including Social Security cards for household members, proof of income, and their most recent heating and electric bills. 
 The Knoxville Public Library is located at 213 East Montgomery Street. To schedule an appointment or learn more about eligibility requirements, contact IMPACT at 515-518-4770 or visit www.impactcap.org .
